exposure: Repetitive pinprick (PP) stimulation during neonatal period
cohort: The participants were term and preterm rats subjected to either repetitive pinprick stimulation or control conditions during the neonatal period.
finding: Repetitive pinprick stimulation in preterm rats during the neonatal period led to increased mechanical hypersensitivity after inflammatory challenge in adulthood, though it did not affect baseline mechanical thresholds.
